name_reason: Follows convention fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. '_4d' is the per-event dispatch-table index 0x4D, verified by table math: entry at 0x51CC5, table base 0x51B91, (0x51CC5-0x51B91)/4 = 0x4D; this is a domain ID (dispatch slot), not an address residue (function lives at 0x35EBE). '__unref_sentinel' accurately reflects (a) no chapter FDFIELD turn-event/tile-step hook references this slot, and (b) the sentinel category (consumed-flag setter only). Consistent with sibling handlers 49/4e which use the same __unref_sentinel suffix. No address residue.
purpose: Chapter-event dispatch slot 0x4D: a sentinel handler that sets tile_event_consumed_flags[0x13] = 1, priming handler_47's 2nd-call mass-kill branch.
logic_summary: Loads the tile-event consumed-flags base pointer (data_fd2_field_map_tile_event_consumed_flags_ptr @ 0x53AD5) and stores 1 into byte [base+0x13]. No other side effects, no branches, ignores its arg. Disasm: PUSH 4; CALL __CHK (Watcom stack probe); MOV EAX,[0x53AD5]; MOV byte [EAX+0x13],1; RET. Self-contained 10-byte stub, no borrowed tail. Pre-setting slot 0x13 non-zero makes handler_47's next invocation (which gates on flags[0x13]!=0) take its 2nd-call mass-kill path instead of merely advancing the counter.
